messages:
jamie: FYI — Acme (acct: 923-ACME) says their month-end invoice total is ~$1,200 higher than the dashboard. Invoice line shows a short 'enterprise' tier charge for 11/30 but dashboard shows 'pro' for the whole day. Can someone triage?

maria_cs: Account id + invoice? any screenshots from the customer?

jamie: invoice: INV-20231130-923, sent by billing-bot earlier. Screenshot attached by customer shows dashboard breakdown for Nov 30 with plan=pro for 00:00-23:59, total tokens match except that invoice added an extra enterprise line of $1,180. Customer is asking for clarification / possible refund.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-20231130-923 generated at 2023-11-30T02:14:07Z. Items: base plan pro, usage tokens, promo credits applied. (automated)

alex_billing: putting on me. quick checks: did they switch plans on 11/30? any mid-day plan change events?

jamie: support notes: they upgraded from pro -> enterprise at 2023-11-30T00:05 UTC (self-serve). They say they rolled back to pro at 2023-11-30T00:07 (accidental). Dashboard shows final state pro for the day. Invoice somehow captured a short enterprise tier window and billed pro + enterprise overlap.

leon_data: running aggregation query against billing_events and usage_aggregate now. will paste the query and summary.

leon_data: ```sql
-- check plan-change windows and token buckets around midnight
select be.account_id, be.event_type, be.effective_at, ug.date, ug.tokens
from billing_events be
left join usage_aggregate ug on ug.account_id = be.account_id and ug.date = date(be.effective_at at time zone 'UTC')
where be.account_id = '923-ACME' and be.effective_at between '2023-11-29' and '2023-12-01';
```

leon_data: query returns two plan_change events: pro->enterprise at 2023-11-30T00:05:34Z and enterprise->pro at 2023-11-30T00:07:22Z. Usage_aggregate rows for date 2023-11-30 have tokens=1,234,567. But invoice generator joined on billing_events without dedupe and produced an extra line for the tiny enterprise window.

alex_billing: that sounds like the known boundary edgecase where we create per-tier lineitems by joining usage to the most recent plan_change event without de-duplicating multiple events within 1 minute. If the ETL sees two plan changes close together it can emit both tiers for the same token timeframe.

jamie: so tokens were double-split and both tiers billed? customer sees duplicate charge for the same tokens?

leon_data: yes — sample from the invoice_line_items table: 
```
account_id | invoice_id | tier | tokens | amount
923-ACME   | INV-20231130-923 | pro       | 1,234,567 | $0.00 (base)
923-ACME   | INV-20231130-923 | enterprise| 12,345    | $1,180.00
923-ACME   | INV-20231130-923 | enterprise| 12,345    | $1,180.00  -- duplicate row
```
We see the enterprise row duplicated due to the ETL job replay that picked up the plan-change twice (race between write and stream consumer).

maria_cs: ugh. customer-visible, needs correction + explanation. Is this limited to this account / day or might affect others?

leon_data: quick scan across accounts for 11/30 where multiple plan_change events within 5 minutes: found ~18 accounts with similar pattern; most had tiny token allocations so impact < $200, but 2 other accounts show > $500 adjustments.

alex_billing: proposed fix: add dedupe on (invoice_id, tier, tokens, amount) when building invoice_line_items; stop-gap hotfix: run a backfill script to collapse duplicate rows for affected invoices and regenerate invoice totals. Then patch the streaming consumer to idempotently apply plan_change events (use event_id watermark).

jamie: can we do hotfix today? customer wants reply before EOD.

alex_billing: yes. I will run the backfill script for INV-20231130-923 now in prod-readonly mode and create a corrected invoice draft. Backfill steps: 1) identify duplicate rows by hash(tier, tokens, amount) per invoice; 2) keep single canonical row; 3) recalc invoice totals; 4) mark invoice corrected and add audit note.

leon_data: i'm running dedupe query now. will paste result when done.

leon_data: dedupe found 1 duplicate enterprise row for INV-20231130-923. removing duplicate reduces invoice total by $1,180. New invoice total matches dashboard within cents.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-20231130-923 (corrected) draft created by alex_billing at 2023-11-30T10:12:03Z. Audit note: removed duplicate tier line (ETL duplication) — see internal ticket BILL-4578.

maria_cs: please prepare customer-facing note: short explanation + apology + credit/refund options. I'll send to Acme and advise them the corrected invoice is issued and we will auto-apply credit if they prefer.

jamie: Customer notified — they asked for a short technical summary and confirmation they won't be double-billed again.

alex_billing: posted immediate PR to add idempotency in stream consumer and added a one-minute coalescing window for plan_change events. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/2412 (WIP).

leon_data: i'll run a sweep for other affected invoices (11/30-12/01) and create backfill jobs. estimated affected invoices: 20, will run through end of today.

maria_cs: update ticket to customer, include reference to BILL-4578 and the PR. cc: support manager.

jamie: thanks everyone. :thumbsup: let's keep this thread for status.

alex_billing: status update: backfill completed for INV-20231130-923 and 17 other invoices; 2 high-impact invoices queued (running now). will post final once queue clears.

maria_cs: noted. Customer happy with explanation for now — will follow up if they want refund vs credit.

billing-bot: Backfill job completed: 20 invoices processed, total credits issued (if auto-apply) $2,860. Created support tickets for manual review: BILL-4579, BILL-4580.

jamie: closing loop with customer and marking thread resolved for support. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
